sophie-support: FYI - customer AcmeHealth hit large spike of 504s to hosted inference around 17:04 UTC. ticket INC-78921. they see timeouts every ~5-10s for ~10m. attaching gateway lines:

sophie-support:```
17:04:12 gateway: upstream_timeout id=abc123 path=/v1/generate status=504
17:04:13 auth-mw: validate-token failed code=429 msg=rate_limited
17:04:13 inference-proxy: request queued -> queue_depth=0.2s
17:04:14 upstream: 502 error from pod/model-infer-5 status=502
```

sophie-support: customer says this is causing page escalations, can we triage? :exclamation:

ashley-eng-sre: on it. can you confirm scope: hosted inference public api or dedicated?

sophie-support: hosted (api.redwood.ai), org AcmeHealth, endpoint /v1/chat/completions. started ~17:04, ended ~17:15.

kevin-oncall: grabbing k8s state now. running quick checks.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/gateway v3.2.1 completed at 16:50 UTC (no errors)

kevin-oncall: `kubectl get hpa -n hosted inference-svc -o yaml` -> showing HPA minReplicas=0 max=20 currentReplicas=1 desired=1

kevin-oncall: `kubectl get scaledobject -n hosted inference-scaler -o yaml` snippet:
```
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: inference-scaler
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: inference-deployment
  pollingInterval: 30  # secs
  cooldownPeriod: 300  # secs
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      serverAddress: http://prometheus:9090
      query: |
        sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",route=~"/v1/.*"}[1m]))
      threshold: '50'
```

maria-eng-runtime: that pollingInterval+cooldown is aggressive. 30s polling + 5m cooldown = slow reaction. also threshold 50 looks high vs normal 10-15 for this workload.

maria-eng-runtime: also seeing many pods stuck on `Init:ModelInit` during the window - model init is ~45-70s depending on quantization and cold cache. if KEDA polls every 30s, scale decisions lag behind actual demand.

jordan-devex: quick note: we recently rolled a small change to auth middleware that now does synchronous token refresh against billing service on first call. if billing is slow, auth can return 503/429 fast which short-circuits requests before they reach queueing/batching layer inside inference. that would make the visible gateway show 504s while the scaler sees no sustained backend queue.

billing-bot: alert: billing-validate rate limit spike at 17:01 UTC -> returned 429 for 00:06:00 window, source=billing-validate-svc

ashley-eng-sre: combining the above: billing validation started returning 429s at 17:01, auth-layer short-circuits calls, so inference pods didn't see a backlog. KEDA didn't trigger because prometheus rate dropped below threshold (requests were failing earlier). but gateway was proxying and hit timeouts. this explains mismatch between customer-visible errors and scaler metrics.

kevin-oncall: `kubectl get pods -n hosted | grep inference` during incident:
```
inference-deployment-5   1/2   Running   0     17m
inference-deployment-6   0/2   Init:ModelInit   0   16m
inference-deployment-7   1/2   Running   0     10m
```

kevin-oncall: readinessProbe logs show model init repeatedly fails first probe, then passes after ~65s. so coldstart is expensive.

jordan-devex: repro steps to simulate locally:
1) run a local stub that returns 429 for /validate-token
2) hammer gateway with concurrent requests (ab -n 200 -c 20) to /v1/generate
3) watch prometheus query and keda ScaledObject reaction

Example curl to reproduce auth short-circuit:
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer BAD" http://gateway/v1/generate &
done
```

maria-eng-runtime: immediate mitigation suggestions:
- increase inference HPA minReplicas to 2-3 (quick patch)
- reduce KEDA pollingInterval to 5s and cooldownPeriod to 30s while we triage
- lower prometheus trigger threshold to 10 so scaler fires earlier
- add a short-circuit fallback in auth to return 401 rather than 5xx/timeout when billing validate fails (so caller gets immediate auth error vs gateway timeouts)
- prewarm model pods for high-tier customers (pin minReplicas)

ashley-eng-sre: I'm going to apply the following now as hotfix:
```
kubectl -n hosted patch hpa inference-svc --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'
kubectl -n hosted patch scaledobject inference-scaler --type merge -p '{"spec":{"pollingInterval":5, "cooldownPeriod":30}}'
# and lowering threshold via prometheus rule update
```

ops-bot: runbook: increased minReplicas for inference-svc from 1 -> 3 by ashley-eng-sre at 17:22 UTC

billing-bot: billing team note: root cause was token service hitting a bug with concurrent refresh and our autoscaler for billing-validate scaled from 2 -> 8 slowly due to its own HPA config. fix deployed 17:28 UTC.

ashley-eng-sre: post-mitigation status: gateway 504s stopped around 17:30 as additional inference pods came up and billing service recovered. customer notified and ticket updated.

jordan-devex: long-term action items (putting in backlog):
- add synthetic auth failure test to staging to catch cascading failures
- make KEDA config per-workload (lower thresholds for latency-sensitive endpoints)
- prewarm strategy for large orgs and add model cached warm pool
- change auth middleware to degrade gracefully (auth fallback + clear error codes)

maria-eng-runtime: assigning follow-ups: eng-sre (ashley) to own keda/hpa tuning, eng-runtime (maria) to add prewarm + readiness improvements, billing to add throttling guardrails.

sophie-support: I'll send customer update and mark INC-78921 as escalated -> engineering. thanks everyone :heart:
